newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian rioters mass in front of police station.
newsitem.headline: Albanian rioters mass in front of police station.

text.p: Thousands of demonstrators fighting street battles in the Albanian port of Vlore on Monday moved on the city's police station and erected barricades in front of the building.

Riot police defending the station hurled stones on to demonstrators from nearby rooftops. Other officers chased out of the city centre earlier in the morning watched from barren hilltops overlooking the street.
Demonstrators, some also mounted on rooftops dragged wrecked cars, metal sheeting and oil drums into the street to form barricades and set fire to them.
Protesters also perched on rooftops and threw stones and whatever other objects came to hand.

The station was the site of initial clashes on Sunday night, when demonstrators threw stones at the building and police replied by firing into the air. One demonstrator died, officials said of a heart attack, protesters blaming police.
A police water canon moved into the crowd at one point, but failed to function properly and withdrew under a hail of stone.
